text:
maria: quick heads-up — i'm kicking off a tiny preflight for the config-preview API (feature flags + runtime params). want to sync on telemetry sampling + console visibility before we flip the guardrail.

jamal: sounds good. what's the probe payload and the rollout window?

maria: payload i'm using:```json
{
  "flag": "new_priority_routing",
  "action": "preview",
  "cohort": "canary-1",
  "sample_rate": 0.005,
  "dry_run": true
}
```trying sample_rate 0.5% for 12h then increase if metrics are clean.

sophia: fyi i'd prefer starting at 0.1% (less noisy) + we need an "anomaly" tag if any change causes: rollout_error_rate > 0.5% OR config_apply_latency p50 increase > 200ms. also include churn_rate metric (changes/sec) in telemetry.

eli: +1 on anomaly tag. also add a metric for "config-fallback-activations" (how often runtime falls back to default due to missing keys).

maria: good call. current dashboard queries i've got:```
# rollout_error_rate
sum(errors) / sum(requests) by (flag)

# config_apply_latency_p50
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum(rate(config_apply_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, flag))
```we should decide sampling for traces too — maybe trace 1 in 10 sampled requests for cohorts, and 1 in 100 for global.

jamal: agree on trace sampling. for the console UX i want preview rows to show: cohort, sample_rate, last_applied_ts, anomaly_flag, link-to-run. can we add an inline "suppress" action for ops to mute chatter?

maria: yeah console actions: preview, promote, rollback, mute-alerts. mute should be ops-only + require a reason. i'll add a small banner when we hit anomaly_flag that links to the rollback playbook.

ops-bot: dry-run created — id: run-20260321-42, cohorts: canary-1(0.5%), will auto-escalate at anomaly.

jamal: can we also record the exact config diff for each preview run (blameable, sha + who triggered)? helps debugging if canary misbehaves.

sophia: +1. and attach a small sample set of prompts/requests used for eval (for routing flags it's crucial).

maria: action items: 1) sophia — add anomaly thresholds & sample prompt set to eval harness (ETA 6h). 2) jamal — console preview UI: show suppress + trace link + diff blob (ETA tomorrow AM). 3) eli — add metrics: fallback activations + churn_rate to prometheus (ETA tonight). 4) me — update preflight script to 0.5% 12h dry-run and wire run-id into logs. i'll post the PR in ~30m (link will be here).

eli: noted. will also add an alert wire for fallback activations > 5/min.

jamal: small nit — can we make the sample_rate field accept decimals in UI (0.001 etc.) and show effective traffic in tokens/min so non-dev folks understand impact?

maria: yes i'll surface the estimated qps and expected token volume next to the slider.

sophia: lgtm. once PR's up i'll do a quick run of the eval set and share findings. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks all — will update thread with PR + run id logs.

jamal: thx, watching the run.
